yoniso pañhaṃ kattā'ti-ādīsu ānandatthero viya yoniso'va pañhaṃ cintetvā yoniso vissajjitā hoti.

90279.meaning1: benefits of ethical conduct; advantage of moral integrity

examples.text: evaṃ bhagavā sīl'ānisaṃsaṃ dassetvā, idaṃ pana sīlaṃ nissāya ayaṃ saggo labhatī'ti dassan'atthaṃ tadanantaraṃ saggakathaṃ kathesi.
pāṇesu'pi sādhu saṃyamo'ti pāṇesu saṃyatabhāvo'pi bhaddako. ayaṃ devatā itarāhi kathitaṃ dān'ānisaṃsaṃ atikkamitvā sīl'ānisaṃsaṃ kathetum'āraddhā.

examples.text: cattālīsāya khalu, samma puṇṇamukha, ṭhānehi itthī purisaṃ accācarati.

kiñ'c'āpi tassā kukkuṭiyā na evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya, aho vat'ime kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyyun'ti.

tvaṃ idha kiṃ karosī'ti vatvā, deva, ahaṃ tumhe sandhāretvā samassāsentī ṭhitā, khamatha me'ti tikkhattuṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā catūsu ṭhānesu vanditvā tāya ākāsaṃ pakkhandāya nāgarājā bhūmiṃ pādanakhena pahari, padaraṃ uppatitvā gataṃ.
kapparato paṭṭhāya pana heṭṭhā yāva hatthanakhasikhā, ayaṃ olambakaparicchedo. etth'antare ṭhitabhāro olambako nāma.
nakhenā'ti pādanakhena pādanakhaṃ, hatthanakhena hatthanakhaṃ ghaṭṭeti. kaṭṭhenā'ti daṇḍakena.

90298.commentary: (SPM) vāccaliṅgānī'ti appadhānaliṅgāni, guṇanāmasaṅkhātāni vā liṅgāni. abhidheyyaliṅgānī'ti padhānaliṅgāni, guṇīpadasaṅkhātāni vā liṅgāni.

90299.meaning1: faith through attainment (of path and fruition)
90299.commentary: (DNa) āgamanīyasaddhā sabbaññubodhisattānaṃ hoti. adhigamasaddhā ariyapuggalānaṃ. buddho dhammo saṅgho'ti vutte pana pasādo pasādasaddhā. okappetvā pakappetvā pana saddahanaṃ okappanasaddhā.

examples.text: tatiyasattake saddhā'ti saddhāsampannā. tattha āgamanīyasaddhā, adhigamasaddhā, pasādasaddhā, okappanasaddhā'ti catubbidhā saddhā.
